samples.question: The gold cross splits the cyan field into odd/even row and column packets. The five rows above it are hidden row positions 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9; the four below are positions 2, 4, 6, and 8. Likewise, the five columns left of it are positions 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9; the four right are positions 2, 4, 6, and 8. Rebuild both axes by alternating from the five-item packet then the four-item packet, ending with the fifth item. Keep the image orientation unchanged. Which arrow appears: up, right, down, or left?
